description: BigqueryVectorSearchAssetComponent — k-NN similarity search against a BQ vector column.

inputs.description: Optional upstream DataFrame of query vectors (upstream_asset_key + query_vector_column mode); omit for static mode (query_vectors set directly in config).

base_column.label: Base Column
base_column.description: Column in base_table containing the embedding (ARRAY<FLOAT64>).

select_columns.label: Select Columns
select_columns.description: Columns to return alongside each match (id, text, metadata, etc.).

top_k.label: Top K
top_k.description: Number of neighbors to return per query vector.

query_vectors.label: Query Vectors
query_vectors.description: Static mode: inline list of query vectors. One row of results per vector.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: From-upstream mode: asset key of an upstream DataFrame holding query vectors.

query_vector_column.label: Query Vector Column
query_vector_column.description: From-upstream mode: column in upstream containing the embedding vector.

query_id_column.label: Query Id Column
query_id_column.description: Optional column in upstream to carry forward as `query_id` in results.

use_brute_force.label: Use Brute Force
use_brute_force.description: If True, force exhaustive scan (no index). Use only for small tables or correctness validation.

fraction_lists_to_search.label: Fraction Lists To Search
fraction_lists_to_search.description: IVF index tuning: 0–1, higher = more accurate / slower. Default uses BQ's choice.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

name: Bigquery Vector Search Asset
